skills.name: commentary-ask-human
skills.summary: Create a durable Inbox question when a response must survive the current chat.
skills.description: Create and retrieve a durable Commentary Inbox question or choice when its answer must survive chat, reach the credential owner asynchronously, or be resumed later. Use chat for immediate clarification and MCP Elicitation for same-session prompts.

interface.short_description: Ask a durable asynchronous human question
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-ask-human only if this question needs a durable Commentary Inbox response.

skills.name: commentary-request-approval
skills.summary: Request a human Decision bound to an exact proposal and consequence.
skills.description: Request and validate a human Commentary Inbox approval for one exact immutable proposal, action, consequence, and current approval policy. Use for durable execution gates including team chains; not ordinary questions or agent-written Decisions.

interface.short_description: Bind human approval to an exact proposal
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-request-approval to request exact human approval and validate the current policy before an authorized execution handoff.

skills.name: commentary-submit-revision
skills.summary: Address durable feedback with a new immutable Interaction revision.
skills.description: Submit an immutable Commentary Interaction revision after revision-bound feedback or an explicit proposal change, preserving provenance and invalidating old action approvals. Do not revise for ordinary discussion or future-facing guidance alone.

interface.short_description: Turn durable feedback into a new revision
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-submit-revision to create a new immutable revision and request a new Decision.

skills.name: commentary-escalate-review
skills.summary: Prepare and follow a human-confirmed handoff to canonical full Review.
skills.description: Prepare and follow a human-confirmed handoff from an exact Commentary Inbox revision to canonical Document, Form, Brain, or Live Preview Review. Use when a bounded response needs deeper review; not to appoint approvers or reroute them through proposal edits.

interface.short_description: Prepare a human-confirmed full Review handoff
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-escalate-review to prepare and follow this request's human-confirmed full Review handoff.

skills.name: commentary-async-workflow
skills.summary: Orchestrate a durable Interaction across polling, Decision, revision, and fulfillment.
skills.description: Resume durable Commentary requests across messages, Decisions, immutable revisions, future guidance retrieval and acknowledgment, external execution handoff, and honest Fulfillment. Use for work spanning sessions; not ordinary chat or ephemeral MCP Elicitation.

interface.short_description: Run a durable safe human-in-the-loop lifecycle
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-async-workflow to run this durable workflow through Decision, revision, and honest fulfillment.

skills.name: commentary-inbox-triage
skills.summary: Inspect authorized Inbox attention and route work to canonical Resources.
skills.description: Inspect and prioritize authorized Commentary Inbox requests and updates using active/history feeds, filters, ranking explanations, and bounded pagination; hand off to canonical workflows. Use for attention triage, not human Decision authoring or source edits.

interface.short_description: Inspect and prioritize authorized Inbox work
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-inbox-triage to inspect my authorized Inbox and identify what needs attention.

skills.name: commentary-workspace
skills.summary: Discover granted workspace Resources and team queues; link and rename authorized reviews.
skills.description: Discover the credential-granted Commentary workspace, authorized Resource collections and team queue; link Resources or rename owned Draft and Web App Reviews when requested. Not browser workspace switching, member administration, or provider permission management.

interface.short_description: Discover workspace Resources and team queues
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-workspace to discover authorized work in the configured workspace.

skills.name: design-effective-interactions
skills.summary: Design clear notifications, durable questions, choices, and exact approval requests.
skills.description: Design clear Commentary Inbox notifications, durable questions, choices, and exact approval requests with concise context, useful labels, proportional consequences, and deliberate full Review handoffs. Use for request quality, not API transport or human Decision authoring.

interface.short_description: Design clear questions and exact approval requests
interface.default_prompt: Use $design-effective-interactions to make this Inbox request clear and easy to decide.

skills.name: commentary-draft-review
skills.summary: Use the Commentary CLI for live collaborative review of local text artifacts.
skills.description: Use Commentary draft reviews from an agent via the Commentary CLI for live collaborative review of Markdown, MDX, HTML, and plain text artifacts. Trigger this skill when a user asks to create, draft, edit, revise, share, or review a blog post, spec, proposal, report, documentation page, or other text artifact with Commentary; when they mention Commentary draft reviews, live comments, watch-comment, review it with commentary, or using an agent and human reviewer together; and when the agent needs to set up authentication, create/sync/watch/share a review, read or wait for comments, reply to comments, resolve threads, manage comments by other reviewers, or decide whether to use the CLI or an already-installed Commentary MCP server.

interface.short_description: Live Commentary reviews for docs
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-draft-review to draft a Markdown artifact and review it with Commentary.

skills.name: commentary-live-preview-review
skills.summary: Set up Commentary Live Preview Reviews and address live web app comments.
skills.description: Set up and use Commentary Live Preview Reviews for web apps through the Commentary review SDK and MCP. Trigger this skill when a user wants to add @commentary-dev/review-sdk or the Commentary CDN SDK to a React, Next.js, Vite, Vue, Svelte, Angular, Astro, static HTML, or other browser app; launch a localhost or deployed live preview review; listen for Web App Review comments through the Commentary MCP server; address selected-element comments; resolve review threads; handle localhost immediate feedback; or apply deployed-review rules based on review owner, current user, comment author, and agent alias tags.

interface.short_description: SDK setup and live app comments
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-live-preview-review to add the Commentary SDK and address Live Preview Review comments.

skills.name: commentary-pr-review
skills.summary: Operate rendered GitHub PR reviews with explicit provider and revision boundaries.
skills.description: Operate an existing GitHub pull-request or repository-document review through Commentary MCP, with explicit discovery of provider support. Use when an agent must inspect rendered files, list or address review threads, preserve provider permissions, check revision-specific approval gates, or continue PR work without duplicating the workflow through the Commentary CLI.

interface.short_description: Operate rendered PR reviews through Commentary
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-pr-review to inspect and address the open review feedback on this PR.

skills.name: review-agentic-plans
skills.summary: Review agent-generated plans for intent, evidence, risk, and decision completeness.
skills.description: Review an implementation plan, technical design, specification, or agent-generated proposal for intent, evidence, tradeoffs, risk, and decision completeness. Use before execution when a plan needs substantive critique; do not activate merely to proofread prose or operate Commentary tools.

interface.short_description: Find plan risks before an agent executes
interface.default_prompt: Use $review-agentic-plans to critique this plan for evidence, risk, and missing decisions.

skills.name: commentary-form-creation

interface.short_description: Create source-backed Commentary Form contracts

skills.name: commentary-form-design

skills.description: Route existing Commentary Form design requests to the focused rendering or form-practice workflow. Use this compatibility skill when a request mentions the former Commentary Form Design skill. Choose commentary-form-rendering for Markdown, HTML, SDK, or custom-renderer mechanics, and design-effective-forms for questions, flow, accessibility, visual quality, or adaptive personalization.

interface.short_description: Design rich Commentary form pages
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-design to build a polished Markdown or HTML Commentary form page.

skills.name: commentary-form-rendering

interface.short_description: Implement secure rich Commentary Form renderers
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-rendering to implement this form in the appropriate Commentary rendering surface.

skills.name: design-effective-forms
skills.summary: Design clear, accessible, unbiased, and adaptive forms.
skills.description: Design or critique a form, questionnaire, intake, assessment, checklist, or adaptive follow-up flow for clear questions, unbiased responses, accessibility, visual quality, and respondent trust. Use before implementation even when Commentary is not connected; use commentary-form-creation or commentary-form-rendering afterward for product mechanics.

interface.short_description: Create clear, accessible, adaptive forms

skills.name: commentary-form-results

interface.short_description: Fetch and process Forms results

skills.name: commentary-form-result-visualizations

skills.description: Create accessible visualizations and dashboards for Commentary Forms results. interface.short_description: Visualize Commentary Forms results
interface.default_prompt: Use $commentary-form-result-visualizations to create an accessible dashboard from Forms results.
